title: Discover's title patterns survive a moving title, and the report names each
objective: The whole of design.md's change, in one package: discover's pinned pattern made from the title's core and anchored at neither end, the ladder to the end anchor and then the exact title where the unanchored core would claim another window, and the report line naming every pinned window. Tests red first in plan_test.lua, then arngz.bats's discover test, help/arngz.md, opt/arngz/VERSION 1.0.1 and the CHANGELOG line under 2.14.0's Fixed. The Ubuntu loop on kovacs before vc verifies.
